usage.callShape: GET https://x402.orth.sh/dome/crypto-prices/binance?currency=btcusdt (required query param: currency; optional: start_time, end_time, limit, pagination_key)
usage.outputShape: body.prices[] (array of {symbol, value, timestamp}); body.total. Latest price = body.prices[0].value
quirks: currency must be lowercase alphanumeric with no separator, e.g. btcusdt / ethusdt / solusdt (NOT BTC-USDT or btc/usdt)
With no start_time/end_time provided, limit is forced to 1 and you get only the most recent price
currency query param is required; omitting it will likely 4xx
usage.guide: Call GET https://x402.orth.sh/dome/crypto-prices/binance with a required `currency` query param (lowercase, no separator, e.g. btcusdt). Pay $0.01 USDC via x402 on Base. For just the latest price, omit time params and read body.prices[0].value. For a series, pass start_time and end_time as Unix-ms timestamps plus optional limit (max 100); paginate with the returned pagination_key.
